Over a relaxed start, the planning crew brought up an idea about handover notes, and we are very sorry that your companion animal journey was disrupted and that the care you expected from Aurelia Skyways did not feel safe or consistent. Your complaint says that the handoff for your pet was unclear, the support you received was not reassuring, and the resulting experience left you concerned about the standard of care.

We reviewed the file as a safety matter and found that a breakdown in communication likely affected the transfer between staff members. That is not the standard expected from the Companion Animal Travel Desk, where we are meant to coordinate care from booking through pickup with close attention to handling, condition checks, and clear responsibility at each step. We apologize for the confusion and for any distress this caused to you and your pet.

<<FACT F113>> Our records show that the reported harm falls within the minor injury process, and the claim review will follow the normal passenger protection path. If you choose to proceed, the supporting statement should be filed through the usual claims channel, and the case will be checked against the care notes, transfer record, and any witness account we can obtain.

<<FACT F119>> Please keep all relevant documents together so the review can move without avoidable delay. We also recommend noting any visible signs, the point at which the concern was first noticed, and any support you sought after arrival, as these details help the safety reviewer assess what happened and whether additional prevention steps are needed.

We are also taking the event back to the team that manages loading, release, and final pickup so the handover process can be tightened. The safety coordinator will examine where the communication gap appeared and whether a clearer checklist or second confirmation should be used in future cases. That review is meant to prevent repeat errors and to protect both travelers and animals in our care.

We regret the trouble caused and appreciate the chance to address it. We will continue to treat your concern seriously and handle the follow-up with care.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
